name: mscse-transfer-window
description: §5.2 criterion 3 — "the courses were completed within a five-year period prior to admission" — applies to the MSCSE as well as the Ph.D. (DGS 2026-09-11). Until then only `phd_transfer_window_years` existed, so an MSCSE student's decade-old coursework was never refused on age: the check simply did not run for them. This student entered Fall 2026 with a completed master's; the 2019 course is outside the window and the 2023 one is inside it.

CS 51000: not counted — completed outside the 5-year window before admission (five-year window, §5.2)
